note: City of Garretson campground in Split Rock Park on the NW edge of town, beside the dam and falls on Split Rock Creek; the RV sites line the entrance road and the primitive tent sites sit in the trees toward the creek. Electric only; the city dump station is a block away at 612 5th Street. Canoe/kayak launches above and below the dam (paddle down to Palisades State Park), a small swimming area, playground and a quartzite visitor center with a snack bar; Devil's Gulch is next door. Active rail line alongside - trains sound through the night. --Claude
